question: Could you tell me the first names of customers who spent less than $1 on albums by the best-selling artist, along with the amounts they spent?

prediction.sql:
WITH artist_sales AS (
  SELECT a.ArtistId, SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS total
  FROM invoice_items ii
  JOIN tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
  JOIN albums a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId
  GROUP BY a.ArtistId
),
best AS (
  SELECT ArtistId FROM artist_sales ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT c.FirstName, SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS spent
FROM invoice_items ii
JOIN tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN albums a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId
JOIN best b ON a.ArtistId = b.ArtistId
JOIN invoices i ON ii.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
JOIN customers c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.CustomerId
HAVING SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) < 1

SELECT c.FirstName, SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS spent
FROM invoice_items ii
JOIN invoices i ON ii.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
JOIN customers c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
JOIN tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN albums a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId
WHERE a.ArtistId = (
  SELECT a2.ArtistId
  FROM invoice_items ii2
  JOIN tracks t2 ON ii2.TrackId = t2.TrackId
  JOIN albums a2 ON t2.AlbumId = a2.AlbumId
  GROUP BY a2.ArtistId
  ORDER BY COUNT(ii2.InvoiceLineId) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
GROUP BY c.CustomerId
HAVING SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) < 1;
